name: nest-react-template
description: Single-server NestJS + React template: one process, one port, SSR and hydration.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @app/shared && npm run start:dev -w @app/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @app/shared && npm run build -w @app/api && npm run build -w @app/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @app/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
